content.short: TownSquare is a modular money market on Monad pairing curated vaults with lending markets.
content.description: TownSquare combines curated, institutional-style yield strategies with modular lending markets on Monad, so depositors can either pick a curated vault or interact with the underlying markets directly. The modular split has become the standard shape for new money markets, separating who sets risk policy from who writes the contracts.
content.meta: Curated vaults over modular lending markets, separating risk policy from protocol code.
